Title: Manoj's Day

Cast

1. Manoj - 34 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Kavita - 60 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Nitin - 63 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Anjali - 25 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
5. Sunita - 27 years, daughter
Look: green saree

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Manoj stands by the road. Kavita, Nitin and Sunita stand near him.]

Sunita: "Manoj, what's the plan today?"

[Manoj starts his scooter and rides off.]

Sunita: "Hmm, I see."

[Manoj drives the car to the office.]

Sunita: "Yes, all right."

[Manoj gets out of the car.]

Manoj (laughing): "Okay, Sunita."

[Manoj rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Manoj: "Careful!"

[Manoj withdraws cash from the ATM.]

Nitin: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Manoj counts the notes and puts them in his wallet.]

Kavita: "What happened?"

[Manoj wades through the knee-deep water.]

Manoj: "Really?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Manoj stands in the living room. Nitin stands near him.]

Manoj: "Dad, look over here."

[Manoj pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Nitin (gently): "Careful!"

[Manoj staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Nitin: "Let's see."

[Manoj presses a cloth to the wound to stop the bleeding.]

Nitin: "Really?"

[Manoj nearly dies laughing at the joke.]

Manoj: "Okay, Dad."

[Manoj waves at his sister on a video call.]

Manoj (gently): "That was fun!"

[The doorbell rings; Manoj opens the door and takes the parcel.]

Manoj: "Yes, all right."

[Manoj laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Nitin: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The main road - Day

[Manoj stands on the road. Kavita, Anjali and Sunita stand near him.]

Manoj: "What a nice place."

[Manoj loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Manoj: "Yes, all right."

[Manoj is killed when a truck hits him.]

Sunita: "We have to be strong now."
